en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1.  Imam  Muhammad  Baqir  (a.s.)  said,  “Whoever  recites Surah Dukhan in his obligatory and recommended prayers, Allah would raise him on the Day of Judgment among those who would be in safety and peace and under the Throne of Allah, his accounting would be easy and his scroll of deeds would be given in his right hand.”
